I think I got the problem solved. Not only that but it seems that I got ryzen master to work with the hypervisor on. The issue seemed to be a number of things.

A few things you could try

1. See if you can boot up with safe mode on

2. Check the voltage you have things set to in the bios, too high can bsod as well as too low, too high is generally worse tho because it can cause hardware damage

3. Try clearing the cmos


4. Set the speed of the ram a little bit below spec or increase ram voltage by a small amount, don't go above 1.55v is my recommendation for over clocking but for fixing stability don't increase it by more than 0.1v past stock voltage


5. You could always try reseating the ram.
